title: The Lantern Key
description:
You come upon a faintly glowing key and go to pick it up.

"Been looking all over for that key! Now if you don't mind..."

 This person looks like bad news but maybe it's not good to be judgy.
notes: Choosing "Keep the Key" leads to a combat encounter with the Mysterious Knight. Defeating the knight grants the [gold]Lantern Key[/gold] card as a special reward. The event ends immediately after the combat resolves, without returning to the event screen.
